name: Archer’s Grace
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You grant the target an extra measure of skill in attacking distant opponents with ranged weapons.

The target gains a +3 insight bonus on all attacks with ranged weapons. The target also suffers only half penalties due to range increments for the spell’s duration.
